Why thinking bigger than your target is the first step.

Kevin Trudeau explains a first step he calls dream expansion. Before you decide what you want, you stretch your imagination well beyond your target goal.

He says to dream and fantasize a little, so your mind grows bigger than where you are right now. In his view, skipping this step makes everything else harder.

When did you last let yourself dream without limits?
